relevant_literal_lines.text: * A Thunder Hammer existed on [[Premia]], entering through the Demon Quest that was located in today's [[Vampire Shield Quest]] that CipSoft created to get more people interested in Premia. The hammer was gained and sold by a Premian char named Morak.

| notes         = One of the most rare and powerful two-handed [[Axe Weapons]] that was spotted for the first time on [[Berylia]]. As it is dropped by [[Morguthis]], one of the stronger (and, due to [[Shredderthrower]]s, more tedious to camp) [[Pharaohs]], it is one of the less commonly seen [[Pharaoh Rares]]. This item, or a similar item can be seen on the counter behind [[Ormuhn]], can not be identified correctly because of a [[Skull (item)|Skull]] above it. It has gained much in popularity after imbuement slots were implemented. Because of its three imbuement slots it is a viable option for anyone using a two-handed axe.
| flavortext    = It is enchanted with ancient magic that renders a weak staff into a powerful weapon.
| notes         = It is a little bit more powerful and lighter than the popular two-handed [[Giant Sword]]. It's rather difficult to obtain as it is very rarely looted from [[Demon]]s.
| notes         = Was a treasured item until [[Updates/8.4|Winter Update 2008]], when this axe was added to the loot of some [[Vampire Lords]] and [[Werewolf|Werewolves]].

| notes         = A good one handed club weapon for players of level 60. However, lootable clubs such as the [[Metal Bat]] and the exceptional [[Deepling Squelcher]] present better options, with the later having only a level 48 requirement. Better to use it in as a second weapon with an [[Imbuing|elemental imbuement]] to kill physical resistant/immune creatures (such as [[Ghost]]s).

| notes         = Was first looted in Lucera by {{Character|Ticones}}, on New Year's Eve. Havoc Blade has gained much more in popularity after imbuement slots were implemented. Because of its three imbuement slots it is a viable option for anyone using a two-handed sword.

| notes         = The [[druid]]'s equivalent of the [[sorcerer]]'s [[Wand of Draconia]] and the [[Ice Damage|ice damage]] counterpart to the [[Necrotic Rod]], which typically makes it more valuable, as [[Ice Damage|ice]] is generally a more useful element than [[Death Damage|death]]. It's the lowest level rod which can be imbued (critical imbuement not possible)

On August 4, 2010, {{character|GM Dragonas}} created a thread that he'd possibly be selling one which on August 6, 2010 he made official that he was auctioning one. You can view original Solar Axes auctions on these threads: {{Thread|3125284|Solar Axe auction! (for real)}} (held by GM Leen Leonhart), {{Thread|3133985|Solar Axe }} (held by GM Exilya), {{Thread|3123530|Solar Axe Auction}} (held by GM Dragonas, the thread held by {{character|Pytru}} (GM Havey), who would choose a Solar Axe, a [[Dark Trinity Mace]] or [[The Epiphany]], {{Thread|3128637|here}}, or in thread made by GM Aestyn {{Thread|3129429|here}}.

| notes         = Strong two-handed weapon for mid-[[level]]s. It has the same attack value of [[Magic Sword]] and [[Blade of Corruption]], two level 80+ swords, while being usable by a level 65. It is one of the most powerful two-handed sword that has 3 imbuement slots until level 200, when the [[Slayer of Destruction]] becomes available.

| notes         = It is notable for being one of the few magical weapons usable by both [[sorcerer]]s and [[druid]]s. For a [[sorcerer]], it is an straight downgrade from [[Wand of Defiance]], compared to which it deals less damage per shot but has otherwise identical stats (save for the two imbuement slots). For a [[druid]], it is a rather valuable weapon though, as it deals [[Energy Damage|energy damage]] which they otherwise have a very limited access to. It has two imbuement slots, but it cannot be imbued with [[Critical Hit]], only [[Mana Leech]], [[Hit Points Leech]] and [[Magic Level]]. Provides 4 sqm of blue light.

| notes         = [[Yana]] will trade you one for 50 [[Gold Token]]s. Wand of Destruction, [[Falcon Wand]], [[Lion Wand]] and [[Soultainter]] are the only wands that may be imbued with Critical Hit imbuements ([[Basic Strike|Basic]], [[Intricate Strike|Intricate]] and [[Powerful Strike]]).

| notes         = [[Yana]] will trade you one for 50 [[Gold Token]]s. It is one of the few rods that may be imbued with Critical Hit imbuements ([[Basic Strike|Basic]], [[Intricate Strike|Intricate]] and [[Powerful Strike]]).

| notes         = This is one of the few helmets that can be worn by Knights which can be imbued with up to Tier 2 [[Intricate Epiphany|Epiphany]] (Magic Level boost) [[Imbuing|imbuements]]. It's also one of the few helmets available for Paladins with this property.
| notes         = It's one of the few [[Rod]]s that may be imbued with Critical Hit [[Imbuements]] ([[Basic Strike|Basic]], [[Intricate Strike|Intricate]] and [[Powerful Strike]]).
| notes         = Falcon Wand may be imbued with Critical Hit imbuements ([[Basic Strike|Basic]], [[Intricate Strike|Intricate]] and [[Powerful Strike]]).

| notes         = An upgrade of sorts from the [[Deepling Ceremonial Dagger]]. It's one of the few weapons that come with a Critical hit chance out of the box (It's also impossible to imbue it with additional critical hit chance).

| notes         = Among the most powerful weapons available for a sub-200 mage, comparable to the [[Deepling Ceremonial Dagger]] (which does less damage but has longer range). Both [[Druids]] and [[Sorcerers]] can use this weapon and it's the only fire based rod available for the former.
It is not possible to imbue this item with [[Strike Imbuement|critical hit imbuements]].
| notes         = It has permanent [[Life Leech]], so it cannot be [[imbuing|imbued]] with [[Vampirism]].
| notes         = Very popular armor due its versality and relatively low price. It is not uncommon for paladins to keep few of them [[Imbuing|imbued]] with different elemental protections.
